answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 6135 Country: India Title: Can a mensurating women perform hajj. In case unexpectely period starts in hajj,can one take medical pills to postpone the mensturation. If medical pills are recommeded, don't it disturb health system of women physiologically. Please throw light on this subject in view of Holy Qur'an and ahaadees. Question: Respected Scholars in Islam, Assalamu Alaikum 1.Can a mensurating women perform hajj. In case unexpectely period starts in hajj,can one take medical pills to postpone the mensturation. If medical pills are recommeded, don't it disturb health system of women physiologically. Please throw light on this subject in view of Holy Qur'an and ahaadees.Thanks.zazakum allah Wassalam Answer ID: 6135 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 996/985=D/1429) It is admissible to take the pill if it is not medically harmful, but avoiding it is better. You should let the period come in its time and learn the Shariah rulings of the condition and perform the hajj accordingly. Taking medicine might cause trouble in future. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
